About Us

Wagholi's Premier Optical Store

At लेन्स प्रो प्लस ऑप्टिकल्स, we believe every person deserves perfect vision. Located in the heart of Wagholi, Pune, we combine cutting-edge Korean optometry technology with handpicked premium frames from the world's leading brands.

From precise eye examinations to a vast collection of eyewear — prescription glasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, and more — we are your one-stop optical solution. Our trained optometrists ensure you get the perfect prescription every time.
